# B2.5 QA sweep — 6 Oct 2026

**Build:** `main` at the B2.6 merge plus R1 (mock data, `VITE_DATA_SOURCE` default). **Method:** headless Chrome (CDP) with mobile emulation, scripted; no code edited during the sweep. **Viewports:** 360×800, 390×844, 430×932. **Not covered:** a real Android/iPhone over HTTPS (needs the Cloudflare preview — A1.6/A2.1), WhatsApp preview card (A2.3), keyboard-only walkthrough, Slow 4G throttling, and deliberately triggered error states (the earlier task-level checks covered those).

Pages: `/`, `/search?q=cake`, `/search?q=zzzzqq` (empty), `/search` (idle), `/category/handmade`, `/category/handmade?sub=candles&tab=businesses`, unknown category, `/b/sweet-crumbs` (Products, Videos, Reviews tabs), unknown business, `/p/aura-candles-vanilla-soy-candle`, unknown product, `/about`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/help`, `/profile`, `/saved`, `/nope`.

Automated checks per page and viewport: horizontal overflow, interactive elements past the right edge, touch targets under 44 px, buttons/links without an accessible name, images without `alt`, ellipsis-truncated text, console errors and warnings. Also: every internal link found on those pages was opened (47 links), the four BottomNav items, and the Profile rows for Privacy, Help, Terms and About.

## Result

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Horizontal overflow (20 pages × 3 viewports) | none |
| Console errors / warnings | none |
| Broken internal links (47 opened) | none |
| BottomNav: Search, Saved, Profile, Home | all navigate correctly |
| Profile rows: Privacy, Help, Terms, About | all open the new pages |
| Missing empty handling | none found: empty search, unknown category / business / product all show their EmptyState with a way back. Error and slow-loading states were not re-triggered in this sweep |
| Blockers | **0** |
| Majors | **0** |
| Minors | 16 (15 touch targets, 1 accessibility) — **15 fixed**, 1 left (legacy) |

## Findings

| Page | Viewport | Issue | Severity | Fix | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home | all | “Tibu home” logo link 32×44 | minor | `min-w-11` on the link (`HomeHeader`) | fixed |
| Home | all | “Use my location” and “Choose area” buttons 36 px high | minor | default button size (`LocationPrompt`) | fixed |
| Category (both) | all | Products / Businesses toggle, sub-category chips and “Today” chip 36 px high; “All” chip 43 px wide | minor | `Chip`: `min-h-11 min-w-11` | fixed |
| Category (both) | all | Sort and Price selects 42 px high | minor | `Select`: `min-h-11` | fixed |
| Category | 360 | Sub-category chips wrapped onto two lines (“Resin Art”) and chip heights differed | minor | `Chip`: `whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0` | fixed |
| Business › Reviews | all | “Write a review” button 36 px high | minor | default button size (`ReviewsTab`) | fixed |
| Business, Product | all | Two `<h1>` per page (header title and page heading) | minor (a11y) | `PageHeader` gets `titleAs`; both pages render the header title as `<p>` | fixed |
| Saved (legacy) | all | “View All →” 83×24 | minor | none — legacy screen, rebuilt in B3.5 | left |

## Observations (not defects today)

- **Product and Business pages show no delivery time or “Est. year”.** Those are the Rev2 page fields (task R2); the data and contract landed in R1.
- **Videos tab is empty on mock data** (no reels in the fixtures) — see the demo notes below.
- Product page title in the sticky header is the brand name “Tibu”, not the product name; the product name is the page heading. Left as built in B1.7.
